items.enunciado: It is better for prices to be agreed upon by buyers and sellers than set by an authority.
items.nota_interna: Q01 ya no tiene espejo: Q03 pasa a medir comercio exterior.

items.enunciado: The state should place taxes on goods coming from other countries to support domestic businesses.
items.nota_interna: Sustituye al espejo de Q01. Mide intervención en el comercio exterior.

items.enunciado: In the economy overall, how do you prefer decisions to be made on what is produced and at what price?

opciones.texto: Decided freely by businesses and individuals negotiating with one another.
Guided by a public administration through a plan.

items.enunciado: When the state helps low-income families, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Giving them money so each family decides how to spend it.
Providing specific services or goods, such as food, housing, or school supplies.

items.enunciado: If the price of a basic good, such as bread or milk, rises sharply due to a supply shock, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Letting the price adjust freely according to supply and demand.
Having an authority set a price ceiling and ration the good by quotas.
Having an authority set a price ceiling, without quota rationing.

items.nota_interna: Reformulado: el escenario es una subida de precio, no una escasez. Opción C intermedia (tope sin reparto, +0.5).

items.enunciado: To allocate a limited resource used by many people, such as parking spaces in a neighborhood, which criterion do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Allocating them by criteria set by an authority, for example resident permits.
Allocating them by price or what each person is willing to pay.
Allocating them on a first-come, first-served basis, with no permits or payments.

items.nota_interna: Las opciones son mecanismos excluyentes (autoridad / precio / orden de llegada), no agentes que puedan combinarse.

items.enunciado: Regarding wages, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having a legal minimum wage that guarantees a wage floor.
Letting each employer and worker freely agree on pay according to their situation.

items.enunciado: If a company comes to dominate almost an entire market, what should the state be able to do?

opciones.texto: Intervene only if the company deceives customers or unfairly blocks competitors.
Limit its size or break it up to encourage competition among more firms.

items.enunciado: To offer professional services or open a business, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Requiring a credential, license, or membership in a professional body beforehand, such as for lawyers or doctors.
Being able to start without prior bureaucratic hurdles and letting each person choose whom they prefer.

items.enunciado: To build a road that crosses private land, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Allowing the administration to acquire the land at a fair price so the project can go ahead, even if some owner does not want to sell.
Building it only on land from owners who voluntarily agree to sell.

items.enunciado: Basic services such as water, electricity, or public transit should be publicly owned.
items.nota_interna: Ya no es espejo de Q30. Mide propiedad estatal de infraestructuras.

items.enunciado: It is better for families to receive public funding to choose among public or private schools and clinics than for the state to run only its own facilities.
items.nota_interna: Ya no es espejo de Q29. Mide elección con financiación pública en educación y sanidad.

items.enunciado: Those with higher incomes should contribute a larger percentage in taxes.
The state should tax large accumulations of wealth or assets at higher rates.
items.nota_interna: Sustituye al espejo plano de Q07 para medir intensidad redistributiva sobre grandes patrimonios.

items.enunciado: Regarding the level of taxes and state financial aid, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Lower taxes to leave more room for each individual and less public assistance.
More public support and financial assistance funded by higher taxes.

items.enunciado: To help people facing economic hardship, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the state fund it through taxes or public contributions.
Having it come from voluntary initiative: families, donations, associations, churches, or mutual aid societies.

items.enunciado: When designing public benefits and services, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Focusing assistance on those with fewer resources.
Extending benefits and services to the entire population regardless of income, such as universal healthcare or education.

items.nota_interna: Focalización por ingresos frente a universalidad en prestaciones y servicios.

items.enunciado: Regarding inheritances of large estates, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Taxing them at higher rates to promote equality of starting conditions.
Taxing them very lightly or not at all to respect family legacy.

items.enunciado: To fund public services and spending, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having those with higher incomes or wealth contribute more.
Having everyone contribute based on what they buy, through consumption taxes like VAT.
Having no general taxes, with services funded by voluntary payments or user fees.

items.nota_interna: Añadida la opción sin impuestos obligatorios. Suma -0.5 (E_rand de redistribución ≈ -0.014).

items.enunciado: It is good for someone receiving financial aid to commit to training or looking for work.
items.nota_interna: Ya no es espejo de Q33. Mide condicionalidad.

items.enunciado: The state should guarantee a basic income to live on for anyone who cannot work or cannot find a job.
items.nota_interna: Sustituye al espejo de Q32. Mide garantía de ingreso, no condicionalidad.

items.enunciado: To organize retirement pensions, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having each person build their own retirement savings.
An intergenerational system where current contributions fund current pensions.

items.enunciado: To fund a project that protects an entire area, such as flood defenses, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the administration fund it through taxes or levies on benefiting residents.
Voluntary contributions from those who wish to pitch in.

items.enunciado: Regarding healthcare, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having each person choose their own health insurance or pay directly for care.
A tax-funded public system covering the entire population.

items.nota_interna: Sustituye al seguro de enfermedad o paro: ahora es sanidad explícita.

items.enunciado: It is valuable to preserve a community's traditional customs, such as its festivals and way of life.
It is valuable for each person to choose their own lifestyle, whether or not they follow traditional customs.
If someone lives with habits different from their surroundings without breaking any law, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Expecting them to adapt to the shared customs of their surroundings.
Respecting their own way of living.

items.enunciado: Regarding how a family is organized—for example who works outside the home, who cares for children, and how chores are divided—what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Letting each household decide how to organize itself and divide responsibilities.
Having laws and public policies back a specific family model, such as marriage with children and traditional roles.

items.enunciado: In schools and public events, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Letting each family or school choose different cultural approaches.
Sharing a common culture and history to strengthen cohesion.

items.enunciado: Regarding alcohol, tobacco, and other substances harmful to health, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the law limit their sale or consumption.
Letting each adult decide for themselves.

items.enunciado: When people with different customs arrive in a community, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Adopting the local customs and cultural norms to integrate.
Keeping their customs as long as they obey the law.

items.nota_interna: Ítem sensible: calibrar en piloto.

items.enunciado: Regarding euthanasia, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the law allow it as a personal choice.
Having the law ban it to protect life at all times.

items.nota_matiz: Euthanasia: a physician helping end the life of an adult with an incurable illness and severe suffering, at their request.
items.nota_interna: Eutanasia. También carga en poder (coerción estatal); se asigna a un solo eje por simplicidad.

items.enunciado: Regarding abortion in the early weeks of pregnancy, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the law leave the decision in the woman's hands.
Having the law ban it in general to protect developing life.

items.nota_interna: NUEVO (aborto). Mismo criterio que Q42.

items.enunciado: Regarding who can enter to live in a country, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Allowing people to move and settle in another country with few or no barriers.
Having each country regulate and control who may enter.

items.nota_interna: NUEVO (fronteras). Carga también algo en coord (movilidad laboral); se deja en un eje.

items.enunciado: Regarding religion and the state, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the state recognize and support the country's religious tradition in public life, such as in holidays, symbols, or schools.
Having the state remain neutral and treat all beliefs—and those with none—equally.

items.nota_interna: NUEVO (religión y Estado). Sustituye al par Q38/Q39 de horarios.

items.enunciado: Faced with speech that many people consider offensive, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Allowing the law to limit severely offensive speech, such as insults aimed at groups of people.
Protecting free speech so long as it does not directly incite violence.

items.nota_interna: Movido a poder_jurisprudencia para mantener 12 ítems por eje y medir regulación legal de la expresión.

items.enunciado: It is essential to always protect the rights and safeguards of anyone investigated or on trial: a fair trial, right to defense, presumption of innocence, and clear limits on arrests and searches.
In serious crimes, it is advisable to streamline procedures and reduce certain formalities to act faster and more effectively.
Faced with a serious crime, what do you prefer to prioritize?

opciones.texto: Investing in helping the offender reintegrate and contribute to society.
Having the offender repair the harm and compensate the victim.
Longer prison sentences to strengthen security and deterrence.

items.nota_interna: Antes preferencia_5 (pena vs reinserción). Ahora eleccion_3 con restitución a la víctima en posición 0.

items.enunciado: Faced with a severe emergency, what do you prefer regarding exceptional government measures?

opciones.texto: Having a judge or parliament authorize them before they take effect.
Allowing them to take effect immediately to respond in time and be reviewed afterward.

items.enunciado: Regarding access to messages, calls, and personal data during investigations, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Facilitating it so investigations are faster and more effective.
Restricting it to specific cases and under a judge's authorization.

items.enunciado: Regarding pretrial detention before trial in serious crimes, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Applying it when there are signs of risk to public safety or repeat offending.
Applying it only if there is a clear risk of flight or tampering with evidence.

items.enunciado: When applying a law to the letter produces a very harsh outcome in a particular case, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having the judge apply the law as written to preserve predictability and equality.
Allowing the judge to moderate how the law is applied to avoid an unjust outcome.

items.nota_interna: Peso reducido a 0.5 para no desplazar en exceso a perfiles garantistas o igualitarios.

items.enunciado: Regarding anonymity online, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having platforms identify their users to make it easier to prosecute online crimes.
Allowing anyone to browse anonymously to protect their privacy.

items.nota_interna: NUEVO (privacidad en internet). Sustituye a la primera mitad del antiguo Q16, fusionado en Q20.

items.enunciado: If a social norm is important to part of the population, what do you prefer?

opciones.texto: Having no external rule at all, with each individual deciding their own conduct.
Having each association or community set its own rules, applying only to those who voluntarily join.
Having the state establish it as a general law for the entire population.

items.nota_interna: Fusión de Q16 y Q20. Suma de poder -0.5 (E_rand de poder ≈ -0.014).

items.enunciado: To maintain public order, security forces should be able to act with preventive force even if that increases the risk of overreach.
items.nota_interna: Contundencia preventiva del orden público frente a contención para evitar excesos (dirección +1 en poder).

items.enunciado: A rule is legitimate only if each person accepts it voluntarily, even if that prevents applying it to everyone.
items.nota_interna: Enunciado endurecido para discriminar mejor frente a la aceptación de coerción legal.

items.enunciado: Mandatory military service helps strengthen the country's defense and civic bond.
items.nota_interna: Reformulado manteniendo servicio militar obligatorio de forma explícita y equilibrada.
